**New app ID.** CardPulse's app ID is now `app.cardpulse.android`, so it no longer has a personal username in it. Android treats this as a different app: it installs next to the old CardPulse instead of updating it, and it starts empty, so enter your server address and sign in again. Once it works, uninstall the old one. Both show as "CardPulse" with the same icon; this one is version 0.2.0 (Settings → About), the old one is 0.1.0. Builds after this one update in place again.

**Everything else is as in build 34:** rapid scan with a results tray, a check-before-add panel (condition, variant, language, quantity and what you paid), and duplicate detection. The build 34 page has the details.
